text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And if that's the case, then...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Nothing... I just realized I probably<n>shouldn't be
asking you this, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I was wondering... Hmm...
choice_data_list: I'm always happy to hear any questions.
I'm always happy to hear any questions.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you. In that case, I won't hold<n>back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering how much you<n>know about
games.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You see, there's a mobile game that<n>Taishin has
been obsessed with<n>lately.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She's been so engrossed in it that I<n>grew short
with her and told her to<n>give it a break. Then, it
turned into an<n>argument.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But after reconsidering things, I felt<n>bad for scolding
her. She never<n>bothers me whenever I'm deep in
thought, after all...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Taishin understands how important<n>thinking time is
to me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't even try to see things<n>from her
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So, back to my initial question...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: How much do you know about<n>games?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm ashamed to admit I don't have<n>the faintest idea
what's popular<n>nowadays since I've never played
any.
choice_data_list: Don't worry! We can learn about them together!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you!

And so, Biwa Hayahide and I start<n>doing research
on popular mobile<n>games together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow. There are so many different<n>genres available.
I don't even know<n>where to start.

I try to think of what kind of game<n>would suit Biwa
Hayahide's diligent<n>and methodical personality.
choice_data_list: How about a famous puzzle game?
How about a hardcore racing game?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've heard of this one! Maybe<n>Taishin plays it
too!
Biwa Hayahide starts playing the<n>puzzle game.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, the next piece is a yellow<n>column...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I slide this square piece to the right,<n>it'll create a
space on the left...

She moves the puzzle pieces around<n>with lightning
quick judgment, and<n>her score keeps going higher
and<n>higher.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I did it! I beat the game!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I understand now. I was a fool to<n>disdain these
simply because they're<n>mobile games.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! This game is actually great fun,<n>and it helps
my focus too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Taishin feels the same<n>elation when she
plays games.<n>Hmm...

The next day, Biwa Hayahide talks to<n>Narita Taishin,
and they have a great<n>time playing the puzzle game
together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm pretty sure Taishin was<n>playing something
like this!
Biwa Hayahide starts playing the<n>racing game.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Ah! I have to turn! No, no! Not<n>that way!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey! That's not fair! You can't just<n>crash into me
like that!

Biwa Hayahide tilts her body this way<n>and that as
she steers her race car<n>around.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I can see how Taishin might get<n>sucked into this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You must calculate your acceleration<n>and max
speed based on the course<n>layout, all while
watching out for your<n>opponents.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'd get pretty mad too if<n>someone started
lecturing me while I<n>was in the middle of an intense
race...

The next day, Biwa Hayahide<n>apologizes to Narita
Taishin, and they<n>have fun playing the racing game
together.
